question: Should ClawSegmentedControl wrap every option set larger than four by default, or should wrapping be an explicit caller-level choice used by Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the demonstrated truncation, but only an Android owner can establish whether multi-row grouping and added component height are intended as the permanent shared design-system contract.

options.title: Make wrapping opt-in
options.body: Add an explicit row-cap or wrapping parameter and enable it at the Skill Workshop caller, preserving the existing shared default for other controls.

options.title: Approve the shared default
options.body: Keep automatic wrapping above four only after auditing all callers and confirming the new height and grouping are the intended design-system behavior.

recommendation.title: Make wrapping opt-in
recommendation.body: Add an explicit row-cap or wrapping parameter and enable it at the Skill Workshop caller, preserving the existing shared default for other controls.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Android UI history shows direct review of shared design primitives and final responsibility for an analogous presentation change.
